features.feature: Create a transaction by uploading a signed contract; AI extracts dates and details
features.quote: upload a signed contract, and watch Nekst AI fill in your deadlines and pre-write your emails

features.feature: Click-to-source citation on every extracted value
features.quote: Hover the green Sparkle icon next to any value to see the exact line Nekst AI used. Click the Sparkle to jump the PDF straight to that page.

features.feature: Tasks linked to contract dates reschedule themselves
features.quote: every task linked to a contract date has already adjusted itself to match your contract.

features.feature: Dependent task offsets (task due N days after another task), re-parentable
features.quote: In a Workflow, a task's due date can follow another task ("3 days after Inspection").

features.feature: 5-step human review before the transaction goes live (verify data, remove groups, key dates, tasks, parties)
features.quote: When it finishes, you'll step through a quick 5-step review.

features.feature: Parties extracted from the contract and matched to contacts
features.quote: Nekst AI pulls the contacts from your contract

features.feature: Email and SMS tasks pre-written with contract details; nothing sends without a click unless Auto-Send is checked
features.quote: By default, Nekst never sends an email or text on its own
Auto-sent emails and texts both send between 8–9 AM in your local time on the day the task is due.

features.feature: Key Dates widget, Key Dates calendar feed, and calendar links shareable with clients
features.quote: Key Dates have their own calendar feed, separate from your full task list.

features.feature: Client portal and client app, Communication Hub per transaction
features.quote: Every transaction in Nekst now has a Communication Hub: conversations that live on the deal, next to the tasks, documents, and timeline.

features.feature: In-app AI chat over transactions, deadlines, notes and documents
features.quote: Nekst AI is built directly into your workspace and understands your transactions, deadlines, comments, and documents.

features.feature: Public API and Zapier on Solo Pro and up
features.quote: Access Public API, Zapier & Other Integrations

pricing.limits: 1 user, up to 5 total transactions, contracts from up to 2 markets; includes contract upload, calendar sync, client portals, AI chat
Unlimited transactions, 3 markets, public API and Zapier, SMS messaging, 4x more AI tokens
2 seats included; extra Administrator $49/mo, extra Team Member $19/mo; 6 markets; assign tasks to others
Any market, multiple accounts, dedicated account manager, company branding
